title: Claude me web search kaise on karein: 2 clicks + source links #shorts
description:
Claude me web search kaise on karein? Sirf 2 clicks, aur har jawab ke saath source links (citations).

Steps (official Help Center ke hisaab se):
1. Chat window ke neeche baayein kone me "+" button dabaiye.
2. Dropdown me "Web search" par click kijiye.
3. "Web search" ke aage checkmark (tick) dikhe, to web search on hai. Band karne ke liye dobara "Web search" par click kijiye.
Tip: pakka search karwana ho to prompt me "Search the web" likhiye. Jawab ke citations kholkar zaroori baat khud jaanchiye.

Dhyan rakhiye:
- Team ya Enterprise plan me pehle Owner ya Primary Owner ko Organization settings, phir Capabilities me web search on karna hota hai.
- Free plan me web search aur fetch aapki usage limit me gine jaate hain.
- Naye Claude experience me web search toggle nahi hota, Claude zaroorat par khud web search karta hai.
